tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Window and panel background (BG). The ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Cards and the active dock tab body (BG_ELEVATED). One step lighter than the ground.

tokens.name: bg-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, idle switch track (BG_CONTROL).

tokens.name: bg-control-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered control (BG_CONTROL_HOVER). Light value derived.

tokens.name: bg-control-active
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected control, selected segment (BG_CONTROL_ACTIVE).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and tab-bar underline (HAIRLINE). Light value derived.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-app and bg-elevated.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Hints, section headings, inactive tabs, units. Never for the only copy of important information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent: switches on, slider fill, active drag handle, selection, brand blue.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered accent control (ACCENT_HOVER).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text. Light value derived to reach 4.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error text. Light value derived.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text such as the far-from-nodes box notice. Light value derived.

tokens.name: window-fill
tokens.usage: Floating windows and dialogs.

tokens.name: window-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline of floating windows.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed track: segmented control background, extreme_bg_color.

tokens.name: faint-bg
tokens.usage: Faint stripe or row background.

tokens.name: inner-card-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of an inner card that groups related controls (one filter rule).

tokens.name: inner-card-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px outline of an inner card.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Hub Blue, the brand colour. Same as accent.

tokens.usage: Night, the brand dark and the app icon tile.
